source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
As the first battle round starts, choose 1 of these:

- Pick 1 enemy unit. Until the battle ends, each attack this model makes against that unit can re-roll its [Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) and its [Wound roll](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls).
- Pick 1 objective marker. Until the battle ends, while this model is in range of that marker, it has [Feel No Pain 5+](vsdata:core-ability/feel-no-pain) and its [Objective Control](vsdata:core-rule/level-of-control) characteristic is 15.
